author: Kyle Hill
description:
In the April of 2026, I traveled through Ukraine for 13 days. In this series, I hope to bring you a side of Chernobyl you’ve never seen before: what the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone was like during wartime, what it takes to provide humanitarian aid to the world’s rarest dogs, and how I captured the first-ever high-definition footage from inside famous the Reactor 4 Sarcophagus. 

This series is made possible by viewers like you, and by the Clean Futures Fund. If you’d like to support the CFF’s humanitarian work with the dogs, cats, and people in and around Chernobyl, please consider making a tax deductible donation at https://www.cleanfutures.org/
